Implement connection state machine with seq-based resume
Implement presence, typing, and read watermarks
Implement auth: getToken contract, proactive and reactive refresh, reauth
Implement offline send queue with durability, FIFO ordering, ULID dedup
Implement message operations: optimistic send, attachments, pagination
Build node backend SDK: token minting, webhook signature verification
Assemble createChatClient and public barrel matching PRD section 6
Add guard tests for core invariants: no framework deps, no secrets logged
Build React binding with useSyncExternalStore hooks
Set up CI: build, typecheck, test matrix, changesets release

nodes.resolution: Absorbed by B1/B5. handlers.ts case 'connection.reauth' exists; B5 additionally fixed it to check tenantId, not just userId.

nodes.title: Emit one wire format: string enums, camelCase, ISO-8601, full six-value ChatStatus
nodes.resolution: Absorbed by B1's projection layer. No integer enum or snake_case key is emitted anywhere on the v2 path; verified by scan.

nodes.title: Add publishable/secret key model and POST /v1/tokens minting endpoint
Resolve tenant from publishable key in WS handshake; reject wrong-tenant tokens
nodes.resolution: Absorbed by B5. resolvePublishableKey resolves the tenant before the token is touched, and a tenant mismatch is rejected with AUTH_INVALID.

nodes.title: Restore multi-instance fan-out for /v2/ws via Redis pub/sub (parity with socket.io redis-adapter)
nodes.blocker: v2 cannot serve production on more than one replica until this lands. socket.io v1 already has this via @socket.io/redis-adapter ^8.3.0.

nodes.title: Authenticate v1 REST chat routes; remove auth bypasses and dead middleware
nodes.blocker: chat.routes.ts mounts 8 routes with no auth and reads tenantId/customerId from the request body. Not yet live, so this is fixed outright rather than behind a compatibility flag.

nodes.title: Close socket.io no-credential agent bypass and WS v2 session.join cross-tenant IDOR
nodes.blocker: socket.io handshake grants roles:['agent'] on any tenant with no token when role=AGENT is passed in the query. v2 session.join checks customerId but not tenantId.

nodes.title: Close v1 socket.io cross-tenant IDOR on JOIN_SESSION/AGENT_JOIN and customer join; stop logging token material
nodes.blocker: B9 narrowed the handshake to authenticated callers, but v1 agent JOIN_SESSION/AGENT_JOIN still has no tenant or ownership check, so any authenticated agent reaches any tenant's session.

nodes.title: Add a unique constraint on (chatSessionId, seq) so ordering is structural, not lock-dependent
nodes.blocker: chat_messages has @@index([chatSessionId, seq]) but no @@unique. Correctness currently rests entirely on Postgres row-lock discipline. Migration against live data, so it needs its own task.

nodes.title: Namespace the API key prefix to dhpk_/dhsk_ so it stops colliding with Stripe's scheme
nodes.blocker: sk_live_/pk_live_ is byte-identical to Stripe's format. GitHub push protection blocked a push on synthetic test fixtures; customers' scanners will misattribute real keys, and a genuine leak would be triaged to the wrong vendor.

backend_repo.note: Separate git repo. B-nodes land there, not in the SDK repo.
